# Get all sent transactions for this month
access_token = login_response['access_token']
transactions = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, direction='sent', min_created_at='2023-05-01', max_created_at='2023-05-31', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'message' in resp:
        print("Error:", resp)
        break
    if not resp:
        break
    transactions.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Number of sent transactions:", len(transactions))
# Extract receiver emails
sent_to_emails = set()
for t in transactions:
    receiver = t.get('receiver', {})
    email = receiver.get('email')
    if email:
        sent_to_emails.add(email)
print("Emails sent money to:", sent_to_emails)
